_README: Hand-authored. Strings that have passed the audit once and are reusable without re-litigating them. Every entry carries the limit it was written against, and the build fails if a string exceeds it, so an over-length headline is caught here rather than in the ad platform. Square brackets mark a fact that comes from the official ministry record at the time of use: they are placeholders, never guesses.
rules: Nothing here states a statistic, an outcome, or a date. Those come from the record at the moment of use.
A new string joins by passing the audit once. It is then reusable for good.
A string that no longer reads true is retired through a changelog entry, not quietly edited.

strings.text: Training, teaching, and tools for the local church. Start with one conversation.
Revival is not coming. It is here. Find out what that means for your church.
For the pastor carrying it alone: teaching, training, and people who will stand with you.
You do not need to clean yourself up first. Come as you are and meet Jesus.
Your influence can outlast you. See where partnership goes and what it builds.
Know who you are in Christ, and what He has already given you authority to do.
For the pastor who is tired
One story from the field, and one thing you can do about it this week.
What we saw, where we saw it, and who it happened to.
Not a newsletter about us. A record of what God did.
THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD strengthens the local church to fulfill the Great Commission, until EVERY1 knows the name Jesus.

THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD strengthens the local church to fulfill the Great Commission, until EVERY1 knows the name Jesus. It works through three initiatives: Revival To My City stirs the local church to return to their first love, the EVERY1 Movement empowers it to do the Great Commission, and the School of the Local Church trains believers to know their authority in Christ.

THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD strengthens the local church to fulfill the Great Commission, until EVERY1 knows the name Jesus. The local church is not a strategy for the plan. It is the plan. Three initiatives carry that work in order. Revival To My City stirs the local church to return to their first love. The EVERY1 Movement empowers the local church to do the Great Commission and walk in God's calling. The School of the Local Church trains believers to know their authority in Christ and build a real relationship with Jesus. Every figure published by this ministry comes from its official record, and every testimony is told by the person it belongs to, with their permission.
